SELECT clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content FROM Club
ORDER BY clubowner_key DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.clubowner_key, club_name, club_logo, club_region, club_status, TO_CHAR(club_created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') club_created, club_content, clubjoin_num, position, height, weight, join_date, status FROM Club c LEFT OUTER JOIN Player p ON c.clubowner_key = p.clubowner_key WHERE c.clubowner_key = #{clubowner_key}
